name: Cloudflare: block IP for the account
description: Run from a case: create an account-level IP Access rule (mode block, applies to every zone in the account) for the case's first IP artifact, and record the HTTP status in a case note. A case without an IP artifact gets a note instead.

params.label: Cloudflare account ID
params.help: 32-character account ID (dashboard: Account home > the account's menu > Copy account ID, or any zone's Overview page, API section).

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token (sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`) with **Account > Account Firewall Access Rules > Edit** (API name *Account Firewall Access Rules Write*) on this account.

setup:
## Cloudflare side
1. API token with **Account > Account Firewall Access Rules > Edit** for this account. Store it as `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, allowed host `api.cloudflare.com`.

## How it works
- The IP is the case's first `ip` artifact. An IPv4/IPv6 address or a range (IPv4 /16 or /24, IPv6 /32, /48 or /64) is accepted; Cloudflare rejects anything else.
- `POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<ACCOUNT_ID>/firewall/access_rules/rules` with `{"mode": "block", "configuration": {"target": "ip" | "ip6" | "ip_range", "value": <ip>}, "notes": "Blocked from case #<id>: <title>"}`. The rule applies to all zones in the account.
- A note records the HTTP status and the new rule id. HTTP 400 usually means the IP is already in a rule or the value is not a valid IP; see the run history.
- Unblock from Security > WAF > Tools (IP Access rules) or `DELETE /accounts/<id>/firewall/access_rules/rules/<rule id>`.

## Why IP Access rules
IP Access rules are not deprecated and work on every plan with one call. Cloudflare recommends WAF custom rules with an IP list for new blocking setups; if you already block through a list referenced by a custom rule, replace the request with `POST /accounts/<id>/rules/lists/<list id>/items` (`[{"ip": <ip>, "comment": ...}]`, permission *Account Filter Lists Edit*).

Docs: [IP Access rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/tools/ip-access-rules/), [Create an account IP Access rule](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/firewall/subresources/access_rules/methods/create/), [Token permissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/reference/permissions/).

## Containment guardrails
A **containment guard** step runs before the action: targets protected in **Settings → Integrations → Containment guardrails** (VIPs, domain controllers, critical ranges) are never contained automatically, and the tenant's daily and per-case caps apply. A refusal stops the run and adds a case note; every action is listed on the case under **Artifacts & assets → Containment**, where an analyst marks it released once undone.

## Playbook tasks
Run from a case task (a playbook task linked to this workflow), the last step records the outcome on the task and ticks it when the action succeeded; a skipped or failed attempt is recorded and the task stays open. Run any other way, that step does nothing.
